about.intro_content: Prof. Li-Ren Li is Professor and Deputy Director of the Department of Colorectal Surgery at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC), Guangzhou. He focuses on multidisciplinary therapy models for colorectal cancer and the molecular mechanisms of tumour metastasis.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Li trained in laparoscopic colorectal resection at Queen Elizabeth Hospital, University of Adelaide, Australia (2003–2004), and later worked as a visiting scientist at Harvard Medical School's Dana-Farber Cancer Institute and the University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center (2010–2013) under Professors Ronald DePinho and Lynda Chin, researching tumorigenesis, tumour metabolism, tumour metastasis and drug resistance. He contributed to landmark studies including the comprehensive molecular characterisation of human colon and rectal cancer published in Nature, and driver mutation landscape studies in melanoma published in Cell.

faq.section_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Prof. Li-Ren Li

items.question: Does Prof. Li-Ren Li accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to colorectal cancer at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Li's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Li specialises in laparoscopic colorectal cancer surgery and multidisciplinary therapy, with a research background in the molecular mechanisms of tumour metastasis.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: Has Prof. Li trained internationally?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Li trained in laparoscopic colorectal resection in Australia and later conducted cancer genomics research at Harvard Medical School's Dana-Farber Cancer Institute and MD Anderson Cancer Center in the United States.

items.question: Has Prof. Li contributed to major cancer research studies?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Li co-authored the comprehensive molecular characterisation of human colon and rectal cancer published in Nature, and contributed to melanoma driver mutation research published in Cell.
